spec.description: Observed increases in the selected period. The first exported nonzero value may be missed, so zero here does not prove that no fee was paid. Fees recorded from transaction receipts, grouped by terminal outcome. Reverted and cancelled transactions consumed fees without a successful execution. Included-unconfirmed means final confirmation was not established. Missing receipt prices can undercount costs.

spec.title: Why the strategy declined · logs
spec.description: Reasons already recorded in the existing ClickHouse logs for this environment. Matching pair = 0 means live inventory had no route for the requested token pair. Blank inventory fields were not recorded for that reason. Counts are retained log observations, not unique orders. Choose the Logs datasource when importing.

spec.title: Since last successful fill
spec.description: Time since the latest successful operation whose timestamp is visible in the selected period. An initialized zero timestamp means no success has been observed; an absent series remains unavailable. Yellow after 1 hour and red after 24 hours without success; this activity warning can also reflect lack of demand.

spec.title: Successful fill amounts · counter observations
spec.description: Observed counter increases during the selected period, separated by token and amount kind. Values are atomic token units; token decimals and prices are not exported with this metric. Do not sum different tokens or interpret planned surplus / expected yield as realized profit. First nonzero samples can be absent from increases. Retained counter peaks include the first observed nonzero value, but can include activity before the selected period and must not be treated as period volume.

spec.title: Quoted amounts · selected period
spec.description: Observed counter increases during the selected period, separated by token and amount kind. Values are atomic token units; token decimals and prices are not exported with this metric. Do not sum different tokens or interpret planned surplus / expected yield as realized profit. First nonzero samples can be absent from increases. Repeated quotes can refer to the same liquidity; this is not executed volume. Retained counter peaks include the first observed nonzero value, but can include activity before the selected period and must not be treated as period volume.

spec.title: Fill outcomes over time
spec.description: Observed successful / failed / rejected fill attempts per second. Retries count again. Rate preserves counter resets and idle windows.

spec.title: Quote decisions over time
spec.description: Decision observations per second, grouped by the recorded outcome. This shows when the decision mix changes.

spec.title: Transaction outcomes over time
spec.description: Terminal logical transaction outcomes per second. Failed submissions without receipts do not contribute receipt fees.

spec.title: Transaction fee rate
spec.description: Observed receipt fee increases in ETH per second, grouped by transaction outcome. Missing receipt prices or an absent initial scrape can undercount fees.
